summary: M&T Bank Corp filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (424B5) to offer depositary shares representing a 1/400th interest in its Perpetual Non-Cumulative Preferred Stock Series L with a $25 per share liquidation preference. The offering is a routine capital raise under an existing shelf registration; no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring is present. Dividends are non-cumulative and payable quarterly if declared; redemption is permitted after September 2031. The filing is a standard preferred stock issuance with no unusual terms, board recommendation, or deal mechanics indicative of a special situation.
